title: 第10章 退婚
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她从后面上剑，一个起跳整个人直接挂钟离珟后背。

“你背着我吧，这样你御剑再耍小动作，如果要摔死，我们就一起摔死。”昭杺柠可是记仇的。

这剑修一开始御剑吓唬自己的仇，她可以记一百年。

面对昭杺柠的威胁，钟离珟御剑飞到半空，冷哼一声：“我要是御剑摔下去，你在我身后，正好给我当垫……呃！昭杺柠你把手松开。”

钟离珟威胁的话没说完，就被昭杺柠环抱在他脖子的胳膊直接锁喉。

这一刻，两个人总算老实了。

御剑的乖乖御剑，挂人的努力挂人。

这一次御剑顺利，总算安全到了峰顶。

本以为到峰顶会看见人，结果昭杺柠发现这峰顶三面对着悬崖，一面背靠山壁修建了一处小院。

除了这个小院，四周没有下山的路。

小院外除了她和钟离珟，一个人影都没。

“你们问剑峰的弟子呢？”昭杺柠惊恐。

她甚至怀疑，这钟离珟是不是想将她囚禁在山顶。

“问剑峰外门弟子住峰底，内门弟子住半山腰，亲传弟子和长老住峰顶，此处是问剑峰最高处，只有我一人居住。”钟离珟回答。

“那你们问天宗的食堂呢，就是问膳堂。”昭杺柠又问：“我好像有点饿了，我想吃东西。”

“问膳堂遍布问天宗各个峰，在问剑峰半山腰有一处问膳堂。”钟离珟回答。

“所以我辛苦爬到山顶，我以为可以开饭了，结果你告诉我山顶就你一个人住，食堂在我的来时路？”昭杺柠受不了了。

“未婚妻，山顶当然不止我一个人住啊。”见昭杺柠崩溃，钟离珟笑答：“如今住在山顶远离问膳堂的，除了我，还有你呀未婚妻。”

“我去你的！”昭杺柠扬手就是一巴掌挥向那张欠抽的俊脸。

钟离珟偏头轻轻一躲，好心情转身推开木屋大门，幸灾乐祸的话音传来：“对了未婚妻，峰顶没有下山的路，想要上山下山，只能御剑。”

昭杺柠快步跟进屋，发现小木屋的布局很简单。

只有一个主厅，一间卧室，一间浴室。

“厨房呢？”昭杺柠询问。

Page (1/3)

She raised her sword from behind, jumped up and landed directly on Zhongli Sui's back.

"You carry me on your back. If you do any tricks with your sword, if you fall to death, we will fall to death together." Zhao Hao Ning is a vengeful person.

She can remember the revenge of this sword cultivator for scaring her with a sword for a hundred years.

Facing Zhao Hao Ning's threat, Zhong Li Sui flew into the air with his sword and snorted coldly: "If I fall with my sword and you are behind me, you can act as a cushion for me... Ugh! Zhao Hao Ning, please let go of your hand."

Before Zhong Lizui could finish his threatening words, Zhao Hao Ning's arms wrapped around his neck and choked him directly.

At this moment, the two people finally became honest.

The one who controls the sword obediently controls the sword, and the hard work of others leads to others.

This time, the sword control went smoothly and we finally reached the top of the mountain safely.

I thought I would see people when I reached the peak, but Zhao Hao Ning found that the peak faced cliffs on three sides, and a small courtyard was built against the mountain wall on one side.

Except for this small courtyard, there are no roads going down the mountain.

Except for her and Zhong Lizui, there was no one else outside the small courtyard.

"Where are the disciples of Jianfeng?" Zhao Hao Ning was horrified.

She even wondered if Zhong Lizui wanted to imprison her on the top of the mountain.

"The outer disciples of Wenjian Peak live at the bottom of the peak, the inner disciples live halfway up the mountain, and the direct disciples and elders live at the top of the peak. This is the highest point of Wenjian Peak, and I am the only one who lives here." Zhong Lizui answered.

"Then you are asking about Tianzong's canteen, that is, the dining hall." Zhao Hao Ning asked again: "I seem to be a little hungry. I want to eat."

"Wenshantang is located all over the peaks of Wentian Sect, and there is a Wenshantang halfway up Wenjian Peak." Zhongli Sui replied.

"So I worked hard to climb to the top of the mountain. I thought I could have dinner, but you told me that you live alone at the top of the mountain and the cafeteria is on the way I came?" Zhao Hao Ning couldn't stand it anymore.

"Fiancée, of course I'm not the only one who lives on the top of the mountain." Seeing Zhao Hao Ning collapse, Zhong Lizui smiled and replied: "Now, besides me, the people who live on the top of the mountain away from the Wenshantang are you, my fiancée."

"Fuck you!" Zhao Hao Ning raised his hand and slapped that handsome face that needed to be slapped.

Zhongli Sui tilted his head and ducked slightly, turned around and opened the door of the wooden house in a good mood, and heard a gloating voice: "By the way, fiancée, there is no way down from the peak. If you want to go up and down the mountain, you can only use a sword."

Zhao Hao Ning quickly followed the house and found that the layout of the cabin was very simple.

There is only one main hall, one bedroom, and one bathroom.

"Where's the kitchen?" Zhao Hao Ning asked.
